    Bug 2012105: Upgrade flatpak runtime to Freedesktop SDK 25.08. r=coreycb
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D280441

diff --git a/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/Dockerfile b/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/Dockerfile
index 507f97168cf..c81b12e9927 100644
--- a/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/Dockerfile
+++ b/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/Dockerfile
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
-FROM freedesktopsdk/flatpak:22.08-x86_64
+FROM freedesktopsdk/flatpak:25.08-x86_64
 MAINTAINER daniel@thunderbird.net
 
 # Create scripts directory
diff --git a/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/repack.sh b/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/repack.sh
index a75637ec604..8f9e114e5cc 100755
--- a/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/repack.sh
+++ b/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/repack.sh
@@ -22,8 +22,8 @@ SCRIPT_DIR="$( cd "$( dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" )" && pwd )"
 TARGET_TAR_XZ_FULL_PATH="$ARTIFACTS_DIR/target.flatpak.tar.xz"
 SOURCE_DEST="${WORKSPACE}/source"
 DISTRIBUTION_DIR="$SOURCE_DEST/distribution"
-FREEDESKTOP_VERSION="24.08"
-FIREFOX_BASEAPP_CHANNEL="24.08"
+FREEDESKTOP_VERSION="25.08"
+FIREFOX_BASEAPP_CHANNEL="25.08"
 
 # Create alias for ideal curl command
 CURL="curl --location --retry 10 --retry-delay 10"
